description: The medieval piazza is seen across its cobbled floor, anchored by the Romanesque church façade at the left with its rose window and arched portal. Palazzo fronts with arched porticoes line the right side, a few people resting on the church steps. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 14:06 Europe/Rome: bright early-afternoon sun.
